ownedNewFiles.proposedContribution: Export versioned runtime request/result/error schemas and task.patchFields, task.previewBatch, task.applyBatch logical handlers. Resolve scoped refs through accepted source binding and authenticated actor; validate typed fields, dispatch existing native transitions, recheck revision/policy/authority and preview digest on apply. Return exactly one outcome per input target, preserving stable row identity/order and related committed refs; use the native effects boundary for idempotency/receipt/outbox. Preview is pure, never a grant or write. Required discriminants: validation, conflict, denied, deleted, offlineUnsupported, missingDependency, rateLimited, unknownFormat. Classify unsupported row capabilities explicitly as specified, rather than inventing a generic success.

Define stable field-ID mappings and portable typed patch/transition values using existing PersonalTask/TaskWhen/native types; title maps to title, status is derived and edited through native completeTask/reopen/cancel/trash/restore, dates explicitly distinguish dueAt from startAt and local-date semantics, relations preserve project/parent/source/link meaning. Derived/system/custom unsupported fields are not spread into task JSON. Explicit clear operations must survive JSON transport; undefined is not a wire-level clear marker. Share portable contracts with the renderer through the existing core boundary, with reviewed export integration if required; no Base task store.

Deterministic isolated native-owner fixtures and seeded tests for five classified row outcomes, source collisions, native transitions, simultaneous CAS, preview purity/digest tampering, revoked replay, same-key changed payload, no-op revision, deletion/future schema, exact native ref/revision/hash readback and crash/restart receipt recovery. Include the specified Base-local-copy mutant with named semantic failure assertions; preserve input hashes/seeds and attempts. No product tests run in preflight.

Use the discovered supported actual Electron runner and existing Task/Base surfaces to edit the same scoped task, inspect partial/skipped preview, apply, reload and read back. Verify pointer, keyboard, Enter/Escape, IME composition, focus restoration, reduced motion, 200% zoom, theme preservation, RU/all-locale behavior and loaded Rox Mono. Include durable-ACK versus pending/draft and denied-without-protected-content states. Runner/host and scope receipts remain prerequisites, not an invented passing command.

risks: Live working tree may change during lead integration. Published source hashes/line numbers are not current proof; rehash before any implementation patch.
Monotonic put is not CAS and single-file rename is not a durable task+receipt+outbox transaction. No-op detection must not bypass expectedRevision.
Existing whole-task PUT and boolean renderer diff acknowledgement can bypass a newly added CAS command or hide partial success; callsite migration must be complete under reviewed scope.
Task channels are remote-eligible in actual routing, contrary to local-only comments; contextless config-root handlers must not be treated as an authenticated personal owner.
Task completion recurrence, move and trash/restore can affect other tasks and metadata. Per-target receipts need bounded native write sets, not one-object patches or mixed-owner atomic claims.
Future schema handling is fail-soft rather than explicit read-only preservation in the current parser; unrecognized valid-looking task payloads must not be silently rewritten by the new command.
Preview digest is not an authorization grant. Policy/schema/revision changes and revoke must be checked at apply and replay; unauthorized conflict/readback results must not leak protected content.
Current global CHANGED signal lacks event identity/revision fences and can leak mutation activity/counts to inappropriate viewers if reused without identity-aware targeting.

Allowed package shared files do not cover real Base/Task rendering, localization, protocol and all caller bindings. Extra source seams require an updated reviewed packet, never an unauthorized broad edit or fixture surface.
Explicit DAG dependencies remain exactly [LSX-WP-002]. Foundation/readiness gates are separate and neither a published issue nor a worker statement satisfies them.
Runtime, recovery, mutation and actual Electron UI verification are deliberately NOT_RUN in this preflight; all feature DoD remains unverified.
